description: This file defines a Java interface named EmployeeDao, which specifies methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting Employee objects in the data access layer of the application.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Interface for Employee data access operations, including retrieve, save, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: retrieveEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object based on the given employee ID.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves or updates the given Employee object in the data store.

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes the Employee record corresponding to the provided employee ID.
